svg.text: Specification-level target architecture: remote persistence, mobile and web clients
Stores users, items, photos, bids and
All server artifacts and components above share this single execution environment.
3-D node = device; nested frame = execution environment; folded corner = artifact.
Solid node-to-node line = communication path (HTTP). Dashed arrow = dependency; «manifest» points from an artifact to its implemented component.

Interpretation: the three primary JARs manifest the web server, application server and database respectively. Database access code is executed within ApplicationServer.jar; no fourth JAR is assumed. Artifact filenames are specification labels, not

Both clients reach the same Web Server over HTTP. WebServer.jar uses web-server.conf to route requests to ApplicationServer.jar, which invokes Database.jar for queries/updates. Database.jar uses sharing-schema.xsd. No client connects directly to
Basis: supplied assignment and Capstone 3 User Stories. Remote deployment is assumed by the task; the supplied Android implementation currently persists locally.
